page_annotations: Apart from b001–b004, the page is blank ruled paper. Mirror show-through of fol. 215 text is visible in the upper and middle areas and is not transcribed.
Fragments beyond the gutter (letters 'd.', 'e', 'f', 'd', 'e', pencil lines and a left-pointing arrow) belong to facing fol. 216 and are not target records.
Underlying leaf edges are visible at the left edge. They carry no writing.
unresolved_relationships: The exact relation between this b.75(5) entry and the cancelled b.75(5) Rathayātrāvidhi entry on fol. 216 (source order 431) is not stated on the page.

coverage.finding: The top-left folio label reads '215' with a superscript 'b' and a dot. The bbox matches native tile 1 at about x 385-505, y 300-425.

The faint pencil note at native x about 2634-2890, y about 1610-1790 is visible. It reads approximately 'n/? d/?'. The second element is written as 'd' with an oblique stroke or ligature, so 'dh' or 'd/' remains possible. No entry stands beside it. Fol. 215 has a similar 'n/?' mark in its outer margin, but that does not establish a connection.
A large pencil X is visible at native x about 2525-2720, y about 2220-2520. No text is attached to it.

Both ink lines and the lighter right-aligned 'n.d.: 8: 8: Beng.' segment, at about y 3590, are present in r001. Several readings in the candidate literal are presented with more certainty than the cursive supports. These are the ṃ in 'Rathasaṃskāra', the phrase 'Opening verse quotes', and the final vowel of 'Utkalakhaṇḍa'. See changes.
